# Release Notes

## 0.40.2 — 2026-10-18

- Production visual PATCH `0.40.2` is deployed on exact runtime SHA `9c48701f1d3dfdfb85a8b99e84795727f4fb2baa` (implementation PR `#44`, exact-SHA validation `39133114542`, manually approved production run `39133463684`). Target-host exact-SHA readback and readiness passed; workflow evidence completed at `2026-10-18T13:57:04.692560+00:00` (not a separately observed atomic activation time). Both installation illustrations are aligned; the installed scene shows a phone home screen, full Vydno icon and no orange arrow. Install logic is unchanged. Real public-asset visual acceptance passed **46/46 cases** in Chromium/WebKit, with shipped-source/asset parity; local 424-browser/31-Node/32-frontend checks and independent review were reused. Renderer-state visual checks are not real-device OS installation or Telegram/provider acceptance. PARTNER-01 `7889 -> 7889 -> 7889`, earlier receipt-quality/authenticated-review and real-owner course/PWA gaps remain open. See `code/docs/releases/0.40.2-install-dialog.md`.
- Documentation-only post-deploy synchronization; this version labels the already verified runtime SHA and does not deploy later main-only changes.
